facts.fact: Kenyans.co.ke reports ArdhiSasa is the government's digital platform for processing land services, including land searches, property transfers and title and lease registration, which an outage notice said were affected.
Kenyans.co.ke lists survey and mapping and valuation among the services offered through ArdhiSasa alongside land administration.
Kenyans.co.ke lists stamp duty payments and land-rent payments among the services offered through ArdhiSasa.
